**Discpress 2.0.1** is a maintenance, performance, and verification follow-up to 2.0.0: it fixes two real throughput regressions caught by cross-version benchmarking, adds automatic idle memory reclamation for warm worker pools, pins the remaining SIMD CD-audio and worker-pool test coverage, and publishes interleaved `v1.8.2 → v1.9.0 → v2.0.1` speed and peak-RSS receipts.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v2.0.1/discpress.html)** (about 3.2 MB): the whole app in one file you keep. If you use the downloaded file, download it again for this version.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad. It updates itself.

## What changed

- **DVD `--codecplan` PCM probe fix (up to 9.6% faster than 1.9.0, ~25–33% faster than 2.0.0):** replaced the simple autocorrelation probe in `chdcodec.cpp` — which false-triggered on 43.3% of non-audio DVD hunks (ASCII text and 8-bit ramps) — with a zero-centered stereo consecutive-pair probe across 8 regions (LE & BE). False positives on `bench-dvd.iso` drop from **43.3% to 0.0%**, while real audio detection improves (`piano.bin` 84.0% → 99.1%, `codec mix.img` 15.5% → 29.0%). Never runs in Tier-R default mode.
- **Faster ARM64 & baseline WebAssembly LZ matching:** replaced `wasm_i8x16_bitmask` short-match loops in `LzFind.c` and `deflate.c` (which expand to 7–8 NEON instructions per check on Apple Silicon / mobile ARM64) with 8-byte little-endian `i64` XOR + `ctzll` under `#ifdef __wasm__`, improving both SIMD and non-SIMD builds while staying bit-exact.
- **Balanced 4-thread CD helper batching:** aligned `worker.js`'s `halfHunks` batch calculation with `chd.cpp`'s 256-hunk work-buffer rounding so 4-thread CD jobs split each 128-hunk half-buffer into 8 balanced 16-hunk batches instead of 5 uneven batches (`[26, 26, 26, 26, 24]`).
- **Warm worker pool idle-reap timers:** idle coordinator and helper workers now terminate automatically after 60 s on desktop (20 s on mobile) and on `pagehide`, freeing WebAssembly linear memory once a batch finishes while keeping sequential jobs warm.
- **Expanded test coverage & documented benchmark receipts:** added explicit SIMD vs. non-SIMD CD-audio FLAC parity (`piano.cue`) and warm worker pool reuse, idle-reap, and memory-cap eviction tests in `tests/ui/fallbacks.spec.js`, and recorded interleaved `v1.8.2 → v1.9.0 → v2.0.1` browser throughput and peak-RSS benchmarks in [`docs/chd/measurements.md`](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/blob/main/docs/chd/measurements.md#8-browser-end-to-end-speed--peak-rss-v182--v190--v201).

## Interleaved benchmark receipts (`v1.8.2` → `v1.9.0` → `v2.0.1`)

Measured in headless Chromium (SIMD, 12-core Apple Silicon, `bench-cd` 64 MB / `bench-dvd` 128 MB, all 3 versions interleaved per workload; 16/16 `v2.0.1` outputs independently verified byte-identical to native `chdman`):

| Workload (4 threads) | `v1.8.2` | `v1.9.0` | `v2.0.1` | Speed vs `1.9.0` | Peak RSS vs `1.9.0` |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `bench-cd` default | 2.10 s · 696 MB | 2.08 s · 657 MB | **2.08 s · 566 MB** | parity | **−91 MB (−14%)** |
| `bench-cd` plan | 1.22 s · 658 MB | 1.20 s · 631 MB | **1.18 s · 559 MB** | **−1.7% faster** | **−72 MB (−11%)** |
| `bench-dvd` default | 4.43 s · 659 MB | 4.37 s · 679 MB | **4.30 s · 563 MB** | **−1.6% faster** | **−116 MB (−17%)** |
| `bench-dvd` plan | 2.91 s · 683 MB | 2.93 s · 677 MB | **2.65 s · 565 MB** | **−9.6% faster** | **−112 MB (−17%)** |

With the default **Universal** target and *Smallest* compression, CHD files remain byte for byte identical to MAME 0.289 `chdman`.
